archetype: ORGANIC & LUXURY WARMTH (Indian Fine Craft & Purity)
theme_strategy: Light Warm Ivory & Sandstone Base (#FAF7F2 / #F5EFE6) with Polished Charcoal (#1A1A1A) and Brushed Antique Gold Accents (#B8860B / #996515). Clean, high-trust, mobile-first local store experience.

colors.palette_description: Soft ivory and warm cream background canvas with pure white elevated product cards, deep charcoal body text, and rich warm gold metallic accents for trust and tradition.

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand identity 'MAHESHWARI JEWELLERS', brand line 'Tradition • Purity • Trust', quick contact CTAs (Explore, WhatsApp, Directions) on left, curated jewellery showcase carousel on right, followed by Today's Rate Strip
entry_surfaces./catalogue: warm ivory filter panel on left/top with metal/purity tabs (Silver, 925, 999, Gold) + active search, rendering a responsive product card grid
entry_surfaces./product/:id: 2-column product showcase — high-res zoomable image gallery on left, metal purity, weight, pricing info, and 1-click WhatsApp enquiry on right
entry_surfaces./about: editorial storytelling layout with heritage timeline, purity testing assurance, Modinagar store location photos and owner note
entry_surfaces./contact: store details hero with direct Call, WhatsApp buttons, Google Maps embed, address and business hours
entry_surfaces./admin/login: clean branded login card with security badges and direct admin credentials
entry_surfaces./admin: high-density management dashboard with rate editor, catalogue inventory CRUD, image manager, and store settings

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body and labels, 3:1 for large display headers)
accessibility.screen_reader: Explicit aria-labels on all icon buttons (WhatsApp, Call, Search, Close, Hamburger)
accessibility.test_attributes: All key buttons, links, inputs, filters, and cards MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="whatsapp-header-btn", data-testid="product-card-1", data-testid="filter-metal-silver")

instructions_to_main_agent.1_core_architecture: Build a FastAPI + React 19 single-page catalogue with full-stack capabilities. Frontend routes: Home (/), Catalogue (/catalogue), Category views (/category/:slug), Product Detail (/product/:id), Today's Rates (/rates), About (/about), Contact (/contact), Admin Login (/admin/login), Admin Panel (/admin).
instructions_to_main_agent.2_mobile_first_design: Most visitors will click from Google Maps on Android phones. Provide a dedicated fixed bottom dock on mobile screens with Quick Call, WhatsApp Chat, and Directions buttons. Keep touch targets roomy and filter drawers easy to toggle.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_today_rates_strip: Render an interactive and editable 'Today's Gold & Silver Rates' ticker on the homepage and header. Admin must be able to update live rates (Gold 24K, Gold 22K, Silver 999, Silver 925 per 10g/1g) from the admin panel.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_catalogue_features: Filterable by Metal (Silver, Gold), Purity (925 Sterling, 999 Fine, 22K, 18K, Regular Silver), Gender (Women's, Men's, Unisex), Category (Rings, Chains, Payal/Anklets, Bangles, Necklaces, Utensils/Pooja, Coins & Bars), and Price/Availability. Include instant search and sort by weight/newest.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_product_card_and_detail: Product card shows image thumbnail, clear DEMO badge (for mock items), purity tag, gross/net weight in grams, price or 'Contact for Today's Price', and 2 quick actions: 'View Details' and 'WhatsApp Enquiry' (with pre-filled product name and code). Detail page includes multi-image zoom, metal specifications, purity guarantee, and direct call/WhatsApp buttons.
instructions_to_main_agent.6_admin_panel: Secure admin panel with credentials support. Capabilities: Add/Edit/Delete products with multiple image URLs/upload, toggle featured/new arrivals, update daily bullion rates, manage custom categories, and update store contact details.
instructions_to_main_agent.7_styling_and_feel: Warm ivory background (#FAF7F2), white rounded cards, subtle gold accents, charcoal text. Do NOT make it look like a sterile high-tech SaaS or a flashy crypto dashboard. It must feel like an authentic, highly respected local Indian family jeweller known for pure silver and trusted gold.
instructions_to_main_agent.8_testing_data_ids: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='catalogue-filter-silver', data-testid='whatsapp-inquiry-btn', data-testid='admin-rates-update-btn').
